query:
INSERT INTO user_emails (id, user_id, normalized_email, verified_at, is_primary)
                SELECT $1, $2, $3, now(), true
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM user_emails
                    WHERE user_id = $2
                    AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
                )
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM active_verified_email_ownership
                    WHERE normalized_email = $3
                    AND user_id <> $2
                )
